displayName.ja: 【未来装備】 水城　ゆきかぜ

profile.ja:
新世代の戦力と期待される若き対魔忍。
代々“雷遁の術”使いを輩出する名門で彼女も亡き父親同様、“雷遁の術”を使う。
“雷遁の術”とは雷を操る強力な術で攻撃系忍法では最強の火力と言われているもの。
その中でも彼女の操る雷撃は強力すぎて制御が難しいため、術を行使する触媒として特別に制作された銃を使用している。
ゆきかぜはその銃に雷撃の弾丸を生み出し、強力な雷撃弾を発射する事ができる。
二丁拳銃を得物に、舞うように雷撃弾を放つその姿から“雷撃の対魔忍”の異名を持つ。
勝気で負けず嫌い、プライドの高さが玉にキズ。
とにかく体を動かして遊ぶのが好きで年中日焼けしている美少女。
profile.en: She is a young Taimanin hailed as the next-generation fighting force. She comes from a prestigious line that has produced users of Thunder-style ninjutsu for generations, and like her late father, she also wields Thunder-style ninjutsu. Thunder-style ninjutsu is a powerful art that manipulates lightning and is said to have the strongest firepower among offensive ninjutsu. Because her lightning strikes are so intense they're hard to control, she uses a specially crafted gun as a catalyst. Yukikaze generates lightning-charged bullets in the gun and can fire devastating lightning projectiles. Armed with twin pistols, she dances across the battlefield firing lightning rounds, earning her the nickname "Thunder-strike Taimanin." She's headstrong, hates losing, and her pride is only softened by her childhood friend Akiyama Tatsuro, the one person she can truly trust. She worries that she can't advance their relationship. A perpetual sun-kissed beauty, she loves to stay active and play outdoors all year round.
